name: google-speech-to-text
title: Google Cloud Speech To Text
description: Transcribe audio to text using Google Cloud Speech-to-Text API
label: cloud,ai

properties.name: serviceAccountKey
properties.label: common
properties.description: Service account key to authenticate an application as a service account

properties.name: encoding
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The encoding of the audio data. Supported values: LINEAR16, FLAC, MULAW, AMR, AMR_WB, OGG_OPUS, SPEEX_WITH_HEADER_BYTE, WEBM_OPUS, MP3

properties.name: languageCode
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The language of the audio data as a BCP-47 language tag (e.g., en-US, fr-FR)

properties.name: pojoRequest
properties.description: Specifies if the request is a pojo request

properties.name: sampleRateHertz
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The sample rate in Hertz of the audio data. Valid values range from 8000 to 48000

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: client
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: The client to use during service invocation.
